pages.text: [#](53341a)If the power of this craft has a lifeblood, the altar is the heart that circulates it. It draws energy from natural and decorative objects within a generous radius and holds it ready for the kettle, the rites, and whatever else you demand of it.[#]()
pages.title: The Altar

pages.text: [#](53341a)Different blocks contribute different amounts. Rowan wood, candelabras, Redstone Soup-filled chalices, placed pentagrams and athames all feed it. Keep it furnished — a sparse altar is a weak altar.[#]()
[#](53341a)Craft the altar, then choose where it will live — it is hard to move, and what surrounds it matters.[#]()
